text:
Nina Gupta: Heads-up from MedTechWorks AP 1212 they flagged the Feb renewal (INV-2027-0021) — platform fee looks prorated incorrectly and support tier charged doesn't match their signed amendment. @CarlosMendez @AishaBrown

Carlos Mendez: Which amendment? I have AMND-1012 for MedTechWorks on file. They moved to Dedicated private deployment Nov 20 and upgraded support to "Enterprise Plus" effective Jan 15 per the amendment. Renewal date is Feb 1 so billing should reflect Enterprise Plus prorated from Jan15-Feb1 and then full thereafter.

Aisha Brown: Can you drop the invoice lines here so I can check quickly?

Nina Gupta: Pasted from portal PDF:
```
Invoice INV-2027-0021
Customer: MedTechWorks Inc
Period: 2027-02-01 - 2027-02-28
- Platform Fee (Private License): $12,000 (prorated 10/28 days)
- Reserved Capacity: $36,000
- Support (Standard): $7,500
- Onboarding credit (one-time): -$3,000
Total: $52,500
```

Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2027-0021 generated by billing-pipeline v3.4.0. Automated rule: support-tier mismatch flagged for account MEDT-0044.

Carlos Mendez: Hmm. Platform fee: contract states monthly platform fee is $18,000, not $12,000. Why prorate to 10/28? Their Nov migration should only have prorated in Nov; Feb renewal should bill full month. Looks like pipeline used last-active-change date (Nov20) instead of renewal term start. That's a bug.

Aisha Brown: Support: Standard $7,500 looks like half-month Standard at $15k monthly. We should have Enterprise Plus prorated Jan15-Feb1 (~17 days) then full Enterprise Plus for remainder of month? Wait renewal is Feb 1 so we should charge Enterprise Plus for full Feb period because amendment effective Jan15 already occurred before renewal. So full Enterprise Plus for Feb. Charging Standard suggests the support tier wasn't updated in customer subscription table.

Nina Gupta: Customer has asked for corrected invoice for AP to approve PO. They put the PO on hold. We need a clear number to tell them and to prepare credit memo if needed.

Carlos Mendez: Quick calc: Platform fee should be $18,000 (not $12,000) => delta $6,000 underbilled. Support: Enterprise Plus monthly is $13,500; they were billed Standard $7,500. Delta = $6,000 for support. One-time onboarding credit should not be reapplied at renewal; contract says it applied only to first invoice. It looks like -$3,000 was reapplied incorrectly and reduced the invoice further. If onboarding credit should not be on renewal, remove it (+3,000). Net correction to invoice = 6,000 (platform) + 6,000 (support) + 3,000 (remove credit) = 15,000. But that would increase the invoice; customer has been undercharged. In this case we need to notify Sales and Legal about billing upcharge vs issuing a corrected invoice.

Legal: For underbills found post-issuance, policy is to issue corrected invoice and request payment; be transparent but neutral. For small timing issues we sometimes absorb but $15k is material — follow up with Sales and the customer with clear amendment reference.

Aisha Brown: Sales prefers to avoid surprise upsells on the first communication. Suggest: (1) send neutral note explaining inconsistency and corrected invoice, (2) offer contact to review if they have questions, (3) provide 14-day payment window on the reissued invoice.

Nina Gupta: Customer contact asked if we can issue a credit instead to avoid confusion. We can't credit to make the invoice higher. For underbilling we reissue an updated invoice and request payment.

Carlos Mendez: I'll open billing ticket and add tests: ensure platform fee uses renewal term rate at term_start and onboarding credits are single-use. Ticket BILL-10023.

Billing Bot: BILL-10023 created: "renewal platform fee prorate and support tier not honoring amendment; onboarding credit reapplied". Status: triaged.

Revenue Ops: We need to estimate revenue recognition impact. If we reissue invoice for +$15,000, confirm whether revenue should be recognized now or deferred. We'll coordinate once corrected invoice posted.

Nina Gupta: Drafting customer message. Proposed wording (neutral):
"Hi <AP Contact>,
We identified an inconsistency on your renewal invoice INV-2027-0021 relating to platform fee and support tier application. We will reissue a corrected invoice that reflects your amendment AMND-1012. The corrected invoice will be available within 3 business days and will include a standard 14-day payment window to help with AP timing. If you'd like a call to review the changes, please let us know.
Best,
Nina (Finance)"

Aisha Brown: Add Sales contact in CC and include the amendment excerpt. Also note that the onboarding credit is a one-time credit already applied; we should explain why it was removed to avoid confusion.

Carlos Mendez: Confirmed numbers and plan: reissue invoice INV-2027-0021R with corrected total $67,500 (was $52,500). Create debit memo INV-2027-0021D? Legal prefers a reissued invoice rather than debit memos. We'll follow invoice reissue pattern and reference original invoice.

Billing Bot: Suggested doc ids: INV-2027-0021R (reissued), CM-2027-009 not needed (customer owes money).

Finance Ops: We'll prepare INV-2027-0021R for $67,500 and attach AMND-1012 excerpt. We will set payment terms 14 days and note reconciliation reference. Once posted we'll update AR and revenue true-up.

Legal: Approve neutral wording. Keep copies of all communications.

Nina Gupta: Sent corrected invoice and amendment excerpt to AP contact, CC Sales, and offered a brief call. Customer replied acknowledging receipt and asked for a line-by-line explanation for audit. Sales will set up a 30-min call.

Revenue Ops: After customer payment we'll coordinate revenue recognition entries. Marking thread pending until AR posts payment.

Billing Bot: BILL-10023 status: fix merged to staging; deploy pending.

Finance Ops: Reissued INV-2027-0021R posted to portal. AR flagged as pending customer payment.

Nina Gupta: Updating thread: scheduled call with customer and Sales for tomorrow. Will close once payment is posted and journal entries updated.

Revenue Ops: Confirming potential revenue catch-up will be processed in month of receipt per policy.

Finance Ops: Journal entries ready; will post after payment. Thread remains open until AR clears.

Billing Bot: INV-2027-0021 status: corrected (INV-2027-0021R). BILL-10023 in progress.
